test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Choose a sentence with no spelling error. **

options.text: He wondered about lots of things.
He wondered about lotts of things.
He wondared about lots of things.
He wondered about lots of thinggs.

solution:
The correct answer is **"He wondered about lots of things."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Option 1 has no spelling error and is grammatically correct.
 
• The word** 'wondered'** is the past tense of** 'wonder',** which means to feel curious or have a desire to know something.
 
• The word** 'lots'** means a large n
